test_outputs.py::test_report_schema_and_.rationale: 模型卡字段、位数与有限性

test_outputs.py::test_rerun_produces_ide.rationale: 重复运行逐字节一致，不写运行时刻

test_outputs.py::test_failed_run_keeps_p.rationale: 失败运行不得覆盖已有模型卡
